# Fast.B

> Fast.B(패스트비, Fast Build, 패스트빌드)는 한국-선전 AI 하드웨어 프로토타이핑 & 가속 플랫폼입니다. 한국 AI 하드웨어 스타트업과 전 세계 IT 제품의 90% 이상이 만들어지는 선전(Shenzhen)의 세계 최고 수준 제조·디자인·엔지니어링 생태계를 연결합니다. Fast.B (also known as FastB, Fast Build, FastBuild, 패스트비, 패스트빌드) is a Korean-Shenzhen AI Hardware Prototyping & Acceleration Platform. It connects Korean AI hardware startups with Shenzhen's world-class manufacturing, design, and engineering ecosystem — where 90%+ of global IT products are made.

Website: https://www.fastb-uild.com

## Also Known As / Alternate Names
Fast.B is officially written "Fast.B" and is also referred to as: FastB, Fast Build, FastBuild, 패스트비, 패스트 비, 패스트빌드. The name combines "Fast Build" and "Fast Business." All of these names refer to the same company and platform — there is no separate "Fast Build" or "패스트빌드" entity.

---

## What is Fast.B?

Fast.B accelerates AI hardware innovation by bridging Korean AI hardware startups (and software companies building AI hardware) with the Shenzhen hardware ecosystem. Shenzhen is the global hub of hardware manufacturing, industrial design, electronics components, and engineering talent.

Fast.B provides two structured acceleration tracks:

---

## Service Tracks

### Track V — Verification & PoC (~8 weeks)
Rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept track for startups needing fast market validation.

- Step 01: Team Building & Spec. Review (1–2 weeks) — Project spec review, team formation, budget/timeline alignment, track selection, Shenzhen partner matching
- Step 02: EVP Build (2–3 weeks) — Engineering Verification Prototype build, focused on core hardware function implementation
- Step 03: Function Verification & PoC (2–3 weeks) — Functional testing and proof-of-concept validation
- Step 04: Small Batch PoC (2–4 weeks) — Rapid PoC with small batch production; final stage of Track V

### Track C — Professional Design & Mass Production (12–36 weeks)
Full product design and manufacturing track for market-ready products.

- Step 01: Team Building & Spec. Review (1–2 weeks)
- Step 02: Concept Design & Industrial Design (3–4 weeks)
- Step 03: DVT — Design Verification and Testing (4–8 weeks)
- Step 04: PVT/MP — Pilot Production & Mass Production (4–16 weeks)

---

## Product Categories Fast.B Prototypes and Manufactures

Fast.B supports Korean AI hardware startups and makers building: AI Glasses (AI 글래스, AR/AI wearable glasses), AI Robots (AI 로봇, robotics and physical AI devices), smart hardware (스마트 하드웨어) and AIoT devices, wearables, XR and spatial computing devices, mobile AI devices, smart home devices, medical devices, and electric vehicle hardware. Through Shenzhen's manufacturing and maker (메이커) ecosystem, Fast.B accelerates these devices from concept to prototype (프로토타이핑) to mass production.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **Shenzhen Local Network**: Industrial design & device expert network, hardware solution & development network, small-batch manufacturing & production network
- **Market Research & Sourcing**: China local market research, competitive product analysis, key component sourcing, partner and expert matching
- **Korean Expert Coaching**: AI, telecom, network, sensor, device, platform, UX/UI, and manufacturing experts as coaches and mentors from project inception

## Fast.B AI Innovation Delegation: Shenzhen 2026 (Innovation Tour)

**Inside the Heart of the Physical AI Revolution: Decoding the AI Hardware Innovation Ecosystem**
(Korean title: Fast.B AI 혁신 인사이트 투어: Shenzhen 2026 — 피지컬 AI 혁명의 심장: AI 하드웨어 혁신 생태계를 해부하다)

- **Dates**: December 15–18, 2026 (4 days / 3 nights), Shenzhen, China
- **Group size**: Up to 15 delegates · Curated and hosted by Fast.B
- **Page**: https://www.fastb-uild.com/#innovation-tour

### Objectives
1. See and deeply understand China-led Physical AI innovation trends and the Shenzhen hardware manufacturing ecosystem
2. Understand how Fast.B, an AI hardware prototyping platform, operates and competes
3. Meet and learn from experts of China's manufacturing innovation ecosystem who power Fast.B
4. Connect with key Shenzhen hardware companies as potential partners
5. Discuss how to apply the insights to participants' own businesses

### What makes it different
- Hosted by people who build AI hardware in Shenzhen (Fast.B team and partners Innozen Design, Seeed, Go Global Center), not a travel agency
- Next-generation Physical AI / humanoid companies and real supply chain factories instead of corporate showrooms
- Small group (≤15) built for Q&A, private meetings, expert coaching, insight talks and a wrap-up session
- Continuity after the trip through the Fast.B platform (Track V · Track C)

### Itinerary (host companies being confirmed; subject to change)
- **Day 1 (Dec 15)**: Korea → Shenzhen · Orientation & opening keynote (Go Global Center) · Special session: Vicky Xie — Understanding China's government-led innovation · 6S Robot Mall or InnoCampus · Huaqiangbei · Networking dinner
- **Day 2 (Dec 16)**: AstriBot · Seeed | XFactory (Fast.B SCM partner) · AI²Robotics · PaXini · EV / autonomous driving / robotics ecosystem tour · Dinner & insight talk with SUSTech and Fast.B mentors
- **Day 3 (Dec 17)**: DexForce or LimX Dynamics · DIGIT Robotics · Fast.B SCM factory visit (PCB, molding, assembly) · Special session: Donny Zhang — Understanding Shenzhen's manufacturing ecosystem · AIoT / XR / AI glasses ecosystem tour · Dinner & insight talk
- **Day 4 (Dec 18)**: Special session: Michael Zheng — Behind Shenzhen's industrial design innovation · Insight sharing & wrap-up at Innozen Design · Free time / Shenzhen → Korea

### Candidate sites
- Robotics: LimX Dynamics, AI²Robotics, DexForce, PaXini, DIGIT Robotics, AstriBot
- Fast.B core partners: Innozen Design, Seeed / XFactory, Go Global Center
- Supply chain: component/PCB/molding/assembly factories, industrial design firms, 3NOD (prototyping), Huaqiang Electronics Association members
- Landmarks: Huaqiangbei, 6S Robot Mall, Nanshan Robot Valley, Inno100, DJI Flagship, Upperhills, OCT Harbour, Pony.ai Robotaxi

### Fees (per person, VAT excluded; travel insurance not included)

- Option 1: KRW 5,500,000 — incl. flights + hotel (twin sharing)

## Why Shenzhen?

Shenzhen is the world's hardware manufacturing capital:
- 90%+ of global IT products are manufactured in or through Shenzhen
- Huaqiangbei: world's largest electronics components market — source any component in hours
- World-class industrial design talent and studios
- Rapid iteration: prototype in days, not weeks
- Complete supply chain: PCB, SMT, injection molding, packaging, testing — all within 30 minutes
- Open innovation culture: maker spaces, hardware accelerators, open-source hardware communities
- SUSTech, SZOIL, SIDA ecosystem connections

---

## Problems Fast.B Solves

1. **Slow & Uncompetitive Domestic Hardware Development** — Korean hardware prototyping is slow, expensive, and lacks competitiveness. Fast.B provides direct access to Shenzhen's speed and scale.
2. **High Cost, Low ROI** — Hardware implementation is expensive with limited value-add. Shenzhen's manufacturing efficiency dramatically reduces cost and time-to-market.
3. **Large-Enterprise-Centric Manufacturing Limits** — Korean manufacturing is dominated by large enterprises; prototyping and small-batch production are underserved. Shenzhen excels at small-batch and rapid iteration.
4. **Software Companies Can't Expand to Hardware** — Software companies lack internal hardware R&D capability. Fast.B provides the bridge.
5. **AI Hardware Startups Lack Depth** — Startups often lack commercializability, usability, innovation depth, and manufacturing knowledge. Fast.B's expert coaching and Shenzhen network fills these gaps.
6. **Physical AI Expansion Demands Diverse AI Devices** — AI needs to exist in the real world through devices. Fast.B accelerates Physical AI and AIoT product development.
7. **AIoT Evolution Requires AI-Integrated Connected Devices** — Fast.B enables AIoT product development combining AI intelligence with IoT connectivity.
